title: Simplicial compatibility of canonical face-cocone evaluation
statement: Use simplicial categories of [lem-coef-simplicial-interval-lifting] and the subset-poset simplex model of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching]. Let $V$ be a finite nonempty linearly ordered set, and let $\mathcal F$ be a family of nonempty subsets of $V$ containing every singleton and closed under taking nonempty subsets. For $F\in\mathcal F$, write $\Delta^F$ for the ordered simplex on $F$. Let $D$ be a small simplicial category and let $f_F:\mathfrak C[\Delta^F]\to D$ be enriched functors strictly compatible under all inclusions $F\subseteq G$ in $\mathcal F$. Write $d_v=f_{\{v\}}(v)$. For $i<j$ in $V$, let $S=(S_0\subseteq\cdots\subseteq S_q)$ be a chain of subsets of $[i,j]$ containing $i,j$, with $q\geq0$. A splitting set $R=\{i=a_0<\cdots<a_r=j\}\subseteq S_0$ is admissible if $T_b=S_q\cap[a_{b-1},a_b]\in\mathcal F$ for every $b$. Define $E_R(S)\in D(d_i,d_j)_q$ as the ordered composite of $f_{T_b}$ applied to the restricted flags $(S_t\cap[a_{b-1},a_b])_{t=0}^q$. Suppose the canonical splitting set $S_0$ is admissible and put $E_q(S)=E_{S_0}(S)$. For every monotone map $\alpha:[p]\to[q]$, with $p\geq0$, the flag $\alpha^*S=(S_{\alpha(0)}\subseteq\cdots\subseteq S_{\alpha(p)})$ has admissible canonical splitting set $S_{\alpha(0)}$, and $E_p(\alpha^*S)=\alpha^*E_q(S)$ in $D(d_i,d_j)_p$. This includes the first face operator, for which the initial subset can strictly increase, and all degeneracy operators.

proof.text: Fix $\alpha:[p]\to[q]$ and write $A=\alpha^*S$ and $R=S_0=\{a_0<\cdots<a_r\}$. Then $R\subseteq A_0=S_{\alpha(0)}$, and $A_p=S_{\alpha(p)}\subseteq S_q$. For each consecutive pair in R put $T_b=S_q\cap[a_{b-1},a_b]$ and $U_b=A_p\cap[a_{b-1},a_b]$. Both endpoints belong to every $S_t$, since they belong to $S_0$; hence $U_b$ is nonempty and $U_b\subseteq T_b$. Admissibility of R for S gives $T_b\in\mathcal F$, so downward closure gives $U_b\in\mathcal F$. Thus the old splitting R is admissible for A. Each restricted flag has the specified endpoints and lies in its support, so the subset-poset mapping-set formula of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching] makes all these evaluations defined.

proof.text: For each b, let $X_b=(S_t\cap[a_{b-1},a_b])_{t=0}^q$ in $\mathfrak C[\Delta^{T_b}](a_{b-1},a_b)_q$, and let $Y_b=(A_t\cap[a_{b-1},a_b])_{t=0}^p$ in the corresponding mapping set for $U_b$. Nerve operators are restriction of functors, as stated in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]; hence $\alpha^*X_b$ is the image of $Y_b$ under $U_b\subseteq T_b$. Strict cocone compatibility therefore gives $f_{U_b}(Y_b)=f_{T_b}(\alpha^*X_b)=\alpha^*f_{T_b}(X_b)$: the last equality is naturality of the mapping simplicial map of the enriched functor. Composition in D is itself a simplicial map by [lem-coef-simplicial-interval-lifting], so it commutes with $\alpha^*$ on each factor. Iterating this defining equation over the r factors gives $E_R(A)=\alpha^*E_R(S)=\alpha^*E_q(S)$. Here the object at every endpoint agrees with $d_{a_b}$ by compatibility with its singleton face, so the composites have exactly the required source and target.

proof.text: Apply [lem-coef-face-cocone-splitting-refinement] to the flag A, with old splitting $R=S_0$ and refined splitting $R'=A_0=S_{\alpha(0)}$. Step 1 checked admissibility of R for A, and $R\subseteq R'\subseteq A_0$ contains both endpoints. The family, order, target and compatible functors are unchanged, so all other hypotheses are precisely those of the item. The cited statement gives that $R'$ is admissible and $E_{R'}(A)=E_R(A)$. By definition $E_p(A)=E_{A_0}(A)$, so Step 2 proves $E_p(\alpha^*S)=\alpha^*E_q(S)$. For the first face ($q\geq1$), $\alpha(0)=1$ and the refinement is $S_0\subseteq S_1$; the same argument therefore covers the potentially new splitting vertices. For a degeneracy the initial subset stays $S_0$, and repeated flag entries cause no change to the argument. The proof also allows $p=0$ and $q=0$.

lean.statement: theorem evaluation_simplicial {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V] [Finite V] [Nonempty V] {D : SCat.{u}} (c : Data V D) {i j : V} (hij : i < j) {q : ℕ} (S : Flag i j q) (R : Splitting S) (hcan : R.IsCanonical) (hR : c.IsAdmissible R) {p : ℕ} (α : ⦋p⦌ ⟶ ⦋q⦌) : (∃ R' : Splitting (restrict S α), R'.IsCanonical) ∧ ∀ (R' : Splitting (restrict S α)), R'.IsCanonical → ∃ hR' : c.IsAdmissible R', c.evaluation R' hR' = (hom D (c.vertex i) (c.vertex j)).map α.op (c.evaluation R hR)
lean.note: The shared evaluation constructions belong to def-coef-face-cocone-evaluation. Splitting sets are presented by increasing finite enumerations; IsCanonical requires range exactly the initial subset. The conclusion supplies existence and covers every canonical enumeration, with no additional hypothesis or arbitrary evaluation map.
